label: rem:assembly-shortest-production
title: The assembly path is canonical: shortest word up to symmetry
html:
Retrosynthesis — asking which reactions produce a target — is famously non-unique. The forward categorical assembly is not. The \gamma\gamma-spine has a canonical shortest path: the Hecke normal form of the assembly braid word. This is the shortest representative modulo the braid relations, selected by the confinement min-action program.

The path is unique only up to the molecular symmetry group. Benzene's D_6 permutes the six equivalent acetylene insertions, so the canonical word is a single orbit representative, not a single word. This is the assembly form of the Gröbner–Shirshov picture: many syntactic derivations collapse onto one normal form, and the min-action confinement program picks it. This is the categorical replacement for a standard synthetic route.
